newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's de Silguy sees EMU on time.
newsitem.headline: EU's de Silguy sees EMU on time.

text.p: European Economic Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Thursday he saw no reason to believe that Europe's planned single currency would not be launched on time.

Asked by reporters whether he was concerned about Germany's internal difficulties regarding a planned revaluation of central bank gold reserves, de Silguy said, "For me, there is no risk concerning EMU. I'm confident the German government will be ready in due time."

De Silguy added that the European Commission had not yet received details of Bonn's plan to revalue the Bundesbank's gold reserves, a strategy designed to bolster the government's sagging revenues in 1997.
He underlined, however, that the principles of European accounting for budgets would be respected and there would be no "fudging of the figures".
"These rules will be applied on a non-discriminatory basis," de Silguy said.
